content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe and Gumroad can fail to deliver due to various reasons, including platform restrictions, high transaction fees, and delayed payouts. When this happens, creators are left without a reliable way to receive payments for their digital products. NOWPayments, on the other hand, provides a decentralized payment solution that allows creators to receive crypto payments directly, without relying on intermediaries. This infrastructure is designed to work around platform failures, giving you the freedom to accept payments and deliver your products without interruption.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your NOWPayments digital store, you'll need to acquire the necessary infrastructure components. This includes a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting platform, a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend, and a Supabase or Google Sheets order storage solution. You'll also need to set up a NOWPayments account and configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Don't worry if this sounds overwhelming - we'll guide you through each step in this comprehensive guide.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your chosen infrastructure components. This involves configuring your payment gateway, setting up automatic webhook notifications, and linking your file storage solution. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT, and enjoy low transaction fees of under $0.10 on Tron. Your customers will appreciate the seamless payment experience, and you'll enjoy faster settlement times compared to traditional payment platforms.
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT and Bitcoin.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves testing your infrastructure, configuring your payment settings, and setting up automatic notifications. With NOWPayments, you'll enjoy instant transaction processing, and your customers will receive their products and payments with ease. You'll also appreciate the flexibility to process payments in multiple cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and USDT.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital commerce stack grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to accommodate increased traffic and transactions. NOWPayments makes it easy to scale your payment and delivery pipeline, with features like automatic payment processing and real-time order updates. You can also leverage the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, giving you everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.

Yes, you can receive USDT payments on Tron for your digital products using NOWPayments, with transaction fees under $0.10. This decentralized payment solution allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving you the flexibility to process payments in multiple currencies. With NOWPayments, you'll enjoy faster settlement times compared to traditional payment platforms, and your customers will appreciate the seamless payment experience.
USDT payments on Tron with NOWPayments are processed instantly, with low transaction fees under $0.10.

You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore additional infrastructure solutions for your digital store.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your NOWPayments digital store, follow these steps: acquire a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting platform, set up a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend, configure your payment gateway with NOWPayments, integrate your file storage solution, and test your infrastructure. Don't forget to configure automatic notifications and payment settings. Once live, monitor your transactions and scale your infrastructure as needed to accommodate increased traffic and transactions.

Creators in Nigeria can convert Bitcoin to naira using a peer-to-peer exchange like Binance or Patricia, or by using a decentralized payment solution like NOWPayments, which accepts Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.
